requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1704-4549-4600--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4549-4600--227.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary creature you control, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 8 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

2374-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2374-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

280-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

618-3991-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-3991-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

323-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

220-5166--86.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause Brash Taunter to take damage (such as its own ability).
220-5166--86.description:
Cause Brash Taunter to take damage by any method.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.

225-4094-4365-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
5231-6972-7932.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3525-6006-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

1621-7936.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dominion Saboteur.
1621-7936.description:
Cast Dominion Saboteur by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Dominion Saboteur enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Dominion Saboteur. Choose to have Dominion Saboteur enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

4125-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Shipwreck Dowser.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Shipwreck Dowser from exile to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-3291-7297.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-7297.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4302-5686-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5686-5929.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

140-2935-3245.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

5686-6553-7424.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

997-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
997-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-4742-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-2079-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

222-527-5147-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2060-2919-3497-4222.description:
Activate Ezzaroot Channeler by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

2457-2557-5794-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

225-880-6517.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
225-880-6517.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1460-2416-2821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-1460-2416-2821.description:
Animate Candelabra using Rise and Shine
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

49-914-1799-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
49-914-1799-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2034-4044-4889-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brass Gnat, adding {C}{C}.
When Brass Gnat dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Brass Gnat on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Brass Gnat from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1397-4015.notablePrerequisites:
Rousing Refrain in exile with three time counters on it.
An opponent has at least seven cards in hand.
1397-4015.description:
Active Rift Elemental by paying {1}{R} and removing a time counter from Rousing Refrain.
Repeat until Rousing Refrain has no time counters on it.
Rousing Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rousing Refrain, adding at least seven {R} and exiling Rousing Refrain with three time counters on it.
Resolve all Rift Elemental abilities from step 1, giving Rift Elemental +2/+0 for each ability resolved.
Repeat.

2882-3705-4891.description:
Cast Squee either from your hand, from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Squee enters the battlefield as a copy of Atsushi due to Infinite Reflection.
Choose to put Squee into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Squee dies, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
